definitions.explanation: The academic study of human history and prehistory through the excavation and analysis of physical remains such as artifacts, structures, and other material evidence.

examples.japanese: {考古学|こうこがく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}ぶ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。
⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{考古学|こうこがく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{専攻|せんこう}→専攻：01587_senkou⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I am majoring in archaeology at university.

examples.japanese: {考古学|こうこがく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{発掘調査|はっくつちょうさ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{貴重|きちょう}→貴重：00223_kichou⟧な⟦{土器|どき}→土器：09658_doki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}つかった→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧。
examples.english: Valuable pottery was found during an archaeological excavation.

notes:
The academic discipline of studying ancient civilizations through physical evidence. Composed of {考|こう} (consider) + {古|こ} (ancient) + ⟦{学|がく}→〜学：09846_gaku⟧ (study/science).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {考古学|こうこがく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{発掘|はっくつ}→発掘：07995_hakkutsu⟧: archaeological excavation
- {考古学|こうこがく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{専攻|せんこう}→専攻：01587_senkou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to major in archaeology
- {考古学|こうこがく}⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧: archaeological survey
- {考古学的|こうこがくてき}⟦{発見|はっけん}→発見：00085_hakken⟧: archaeological discovery
- ⟦{考古学者|こうこがくしゃ}→考古学者：09657_koukogakusha⟧: archaeologist

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{歴史学|れきしがく}→歴史学：23679_rekishigaku⟧: history (as an academic discipline) — uses written records rather than physical remains
- ⟦{人類学|じんるいがく}→人類学：17227_jinruigaku⟧: anthropology — broader study of human societies and cultures
- ⟦{古代|こだい}→古代：05324_kodai⟧: ancient times — a time period that archaeology often focuses on
